ai_summary.key_headline: Norway's Upset Momentum Faces England's Title Pressure
tactical_insights: England's strategy will focus on neutralizing Erling Haaland, with Nico O'Reilly's insights crucial against his Manchester City teammate.
Norway's stunning upset against five-time champions Brazil in the Round of 16 provides immense momentum and confidence for their quarter-final.
England's tactical priority is cutting supply lines to Haaland, while Norway's well-organized setup aims to exploit England's defensive focus.
